title: Australia
subtitle: City lanes and river lights, kangaroos and penguins, then a road along Victoria’s coast to the Twelve Apostles.
location: Melbourne · Williamstown · St Kilda · Great Ocean Road

chapters.title: First walks through Melbourne
paragraphs: Laneways, patterned façades and a glass dome introduce the city. After rain, the street lights leave colour across the pavement.

chapters.title: Courtyards and river lights

chapters.title: Trams, birds and Federation Square
paragraphs: A green tram passes old stone buildings, a lorikeet forages beside the pavement, and a crowd fills Federation Square. The train carries the afternoon towards the bay.

chapters.title: An evening beside the bay
paragraphs: Rock pools, low coastal plants and black swans line the waterfront. As the light fades, the city becomes a distant line beyond the boats.

chapters.title: From the city to the evening sea
paragraphs: Courtyards and a street musician give way to the open water at Point Ormond. Gulls cross the sunset, and the walk ends among palms and lit restaurant windows.

chapters.title: Out along St Kilda Pier
paragraphs: After the city streets, St Kilda is all dark water and long strings of pier lights. Little penguins stand among the breakwater rocks before the late journey back.

chapters.title: A walk through Westerfolds

chapters.title: The first stretches of the Great Ocean Road
paragraphs: The coast opens below the road under a shifting sky. Steps lead down to the surf, flowers grow beside the lookouts, and the road follows the edge of the water.

chapters.title: Headlands and river birds
paragraphs: The road curls around green headlands, with short walks down wooden steps and through reeds. At Kennett River, birds perch above the water and a cockatoo waits beside the road.

chapters.title: Through the Otways
paragraphs: Tall trunks close around the road before the coast appears again at Cape Otway. Beyond the lighthouse headland, sheep graze in fields and long surf rolls into Castle Cove.

chapters.title: Sea stacks, a rainbow and the Grotto
chapters.location: Twelve Apostles · Loch Ard Gorge · The Grotto
paragraphs: Evening light moves across the limestone coast and a rainbow hangs above the sea stacks. The last stops follow a narrow gorge and a boardwalk to the Grotto as dusk settles over the water.

chapters.title: A last evening in Melbourne
paragraphs: Back in the city, there is time for a sweet snack, another tram ride and a final meal. Bright window displays bring the journey back to the streets where it began.
